Observed and predicted flow maps for every city and model, and the relationship
between each accessibility measure and the informality rate of the home zone.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")
sys.path.append(".")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.image as mpimg
from pathlib import Path
from scipy import stats

from data_processing import load_and_prepare_data, preprocess_data
from models import (
    optimize_utility_model,
    optimize_gravity_pow_model,
    optimize_radiation_extended,
    optimize_bms_plausible_model,
)
from accessibility import process_accessibility_data, winsorise
from si_plots import (
    plot_flow_map,
    assemble_unified_figure,

)

```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = Path("../../figs/SI")
FIGS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

CITY_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": ("../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson", "../../data/bay_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Los Angeles": ("../../data/h3_la_8.geojson", "../../data/la_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Mexico City": ("../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson", "../../data/cdmx_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Rio de Janeiro": ("../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson", "../../data/rio_flows_h3_8h3.csv"),
}

ROW_INFO = [
    ("z_dist", "a)  Distance-weighted accessibility"),
    ("z_surp", "b)  Consumer-surplus accessibility"),
    ("z_mean", "c)  Combined accessibility"),
]
```

## Load Data and Fit Every Model

```{python}
all_city_data = {}
all_models = {}
zone_data = {}

for city, (mzn_path, flows_path) in CITY_PATHS.items():
    aligned, mzn, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, home_m, inf_m, _ = load_and_prepare_data(
        mzn_path, flows_path, city
    )
    median_informality = mzn["informality_rate"].median()
    aligned["informality_level"] = np.where(
        aligned["informality_rate"] < median_informality, "Low", "High"
    )
    zone_data[city] = mzn

    (distance, distance_log, eci, flows, informality, home_population,
     work_population, distance_min, distance_diff, *_) = preprocess_data(
        home_m, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, inf_m
    )
    zones = list(flows_m.index)

    all_city_data[city] = {
        "aligned_data": aligned, "mzn": mzn, "distance_matrix": dist_m,
        "distance": distance, "distance_log": distance_log, "eci": eci,
        "flows": flows, "informality": informality,
        "home_population": home_population, "work_population": work_population,
        "distance_min": distance_min, "distance_diff": distance_diff,
        "zones": zones,
    }

    params, predictions = optimize_utility_model(
        distance_log, eci, flows, informality, home_population, True, city
    )
    all_models[city] = {
        "Utility": (params, predictions, 5),
        "Gravity": (*optimize_gravity_pow_model(
            distance, home_population, work_population, flows), 4),
        "Radiation Ext": (*optimize_radiation_extended(
            distance, home_population, work_population, flows), 1),
        "BMS Plausible": (*optimize_bms_plausible_model(
            distance, home_population, work_population, flows), 6),
    }
```

## Flow Maps

```{python}
DISPLAY_NAMES = {"Utility": "WorkReach model", "Gravity": "Gravity model",
                 "Radiation Ext": "Extended Radiation model",
                 "BMS Plausible": "BMS Plausible model"}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    data = all_city_data[city]
    observed = data["aligned_data"]
    projected = project_for_mapping(data["mzn"], city).set_index("geomid")

    positive = observed.loc[observed.flows > 0, "flows"]
    ref_min, ref_max = positive.min(), positive.max()
    slug = city.replace(" ", "_")

    fig = plot_flow_map(observed, projected, ref_min, ref_max, city)
    fig.savefig(FIGS_DIR / f"{slug}_observed.png", dpi=300,
                facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
    plt.close(fig)

    for name, (_, prediction, _) in all_models[city].items():
        predicted = pd.DataFrame(prediction, index=data["zones"], columns=data["zones"])
        predicted = predicted.stack().reset_index()
        predicted.columns = ["home_geomid", "work_geomid", "flows"]
        predicted["flows"] = np.round(predicted["flows"]).astype(int)

        fig = plot_flow_map(predicted, projected, ref_min, ref_max, city)
        fig.savefig(FIGS_DIR / f"{slug}_{name}_model.png", dpi=300,
                    facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
        plt.close(fig)

    print(f"{city}: flow maps saved")
```

```{python}
PANEL_ORDER = ["Observed", "BMS Plausible", "Gravity", "Radiation Ext", "Utility"]

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    slug = city.replace(" ", "_")
    panels = {}
    for name in PANEL_ORDER:
        path = (FIGS_DIR / f"{slug}_observed.png" if name == "Observed"
                else FIGS_DIR / f"{slug}_{name}_model.png")
        panels[DISPLAY_NAMES.get(name, name)] = mpimg.imread(path)

    fig = assemble_unified_figure(city, panels)
    fig.savefig(FIGS_DIR / f"{slug}_unified_comparison.pdf", dpi=300,
                bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"{city}: unified comparison saved")
```

## Accessibility against Informality

```{python}
combined_accessibility_df, _ = process_accessibility_data(all_city_data, all_models)

z_scores = combined_accessibility_df.query("Model == 'Utility'").copy()
for source, column in (("distance_weighted_accessibility", "z_dist"),
                       ("surplus_accessibility", "z_surp")):
    z_scores[column] = z_scores.groupby("City")[source].transform(
        stats.zscore, nan_policy="omit")
    z_scores[column] = z_scores.groupby("City")[column].transform(winsorise)
    z_scores[column] = z_scores.groupby("City")[column].transform(
        lambda x: (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=0))

z_scores = z_scores.dropna(subset=["z_dist", "z_surp"])
z_scores["z_mean"] = winsorise((z_scores["z_dist"] + z_scores["z_surp"]) / 2.0)
```

```{python}
fig = plot_accessibility_vs_informality(zone_data, z_scores, CITY_ORDER, ROW_INFO)
fig.savefig(FIGS_DIR / "accessibility_scatters.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
```
